description: This file manages sandbox containers and browsers, including listing and removing sandbox containers and browsers, interacting with registry entries, and managing runtime descriptions.

methods.name: toBrowserDockerRuntimeEntry
methods.description: Converts a SandboxBrowserRegistryEntry to a SandboxRegistryEntry with specific runtime labels and backend ID.

methods.name: listSandboxContainers
methods.description: Lists all sandbox containers with their runtime status and image match info.

methods.name: listSandboxBrowsers
methods.description: Lists all sandbox browsers with their runtime status and image match info.

methods.name: removeSandboxContainer
methods.description: Removes a sandbox container by name, updating registry and runtime.

methods.name: removeSandboxBrowserContainer
methods.description: Removes a sandbox browser container by name, updating registry, runtime, and stopping associated browser bridge server.
